description:
5SRE - O Dowd & Larkin are delighted to present this bright mid-terrace house at 60 Cookes Terrace, Bohermore, Galway City.

This property is located in an established residential area walking distance to Galway city centre. Local amenities including shops, schools, and public transport are nearby.

The accommodation is arranged over two floors and comprises:
- Entrance hallway with stairs to the first floor
- Sitting room with fireplace and built-in storage
- Kitchen/dining room with fitted wooden units, tiled floor, and outlook to the rear garden
- Ground-floor bathroom
- One bedroom downstairs
- Two bedrooms upstairs sharing toilet and wash

Outside there is a driveway to the front providing off-street parking, together with a small lawned area. To the rear is a private enclosed garden with lawn, bounded by high stone walls. There are sheds to the rear with renovation possibilities.

Additional information
- Floor area approximately 80 m²
- BER Rating F
- Oil-fired central heating
- Double-glazed windows

Viewings can be arranged through 5SRE O Dowd & Larkin.
